title: Centralize Terraform parameter surface and migrate env-specific overlays to module contracts
creator: Maya Chen
description: Background: Over the last three years we've accumulated a pattern of environment-specific Terraform overlays (staging/prod/dev) that copy large parts of networking and service modules and tweak a handful of variables. This duplication makes provider upgrades and network template changes high risk and slows down rollouts. Goal: Consolidate variable surface into centralized, explicit module contracts and migrate overlays to thin param files + workspaces. Reduce duplicated logic in networking templates, simplify EIP/NAT lifecycle handling, and prepare for AWS provider v5 upgrade with minimal blast radius.
acceptance_criteria: Top-level module inputs are reduced to a small, documented contract for networking and service modules
Existing env overlays replaced with workspace-backed param files in git for prod/stage/dev
No functional differences in networking (routing, NAT, EIP allocation) after migration validated by staging smoke tests
Terraform plan/apply for a sample workspace (staging) succeeds with new module contracts and provider pinned to v4.x during migration
Migration playbook + rollback steps documented in Confluence and linked in the ticket
activity: 2025-02-11: Kickoff meeting — agreed to use workspaces + a single variable schema for core modules. Attendees: Maya, Arjun, Leila (Platform), Diego (Security).

2025-02-14: Spike completed — identified five modules with duplicated logic (vpc, nat, eip, alb, route53). Proposed API: module inputs trimmed to {region, cidr_blocks, nat_mode, eip_policy, private_subnet_map}.
2025-02-20: Prototype branch created (github.com/redwood/infra/tree/ENG-140001-param-contract). Implemented module adapter layer that accepts old and new input shapes for backward compatibility.
2025-02-24: Review feedback from Leila: prefer explicit 'eip_lifecycle' enum over boolean flags to avoid accidental replacements. Updated prototype accordingly.

2025-02-27: Discovered plan diffs in cross-account route tables when applying centralized module to a test workspace — root cause: overlay was implicitly creating route attachments. Added migration step to convert attachments to explicit resource blocks and wrote idempotent import script.

2025-03-03: Created staging workspaces and param files. Ran smoke apply against non-prod; observed transient drift for ephemeral EIPs. Decided to adopt a sticky EIP naming convention and annotate allocations for better lifecycle handling.

2025-03-05: Design review with Infrastructure squad. Approved approach to: 1) land module contract PRs behind feature-flagged release branch, 2) run canary workspace apply for one service, 3) monitor telemetry and SLOs for 48h before full rollout.
Next steps: finalize import scripts, open PRs to central module repo, coordinate scheduled maintenance window for prod canary with SRE.
